steps.say: Three bars on each class, answering the question a total cannot: is this normal. The top bar is **Class** — the cycles your own class has done.
**School** underneath it is the average across the other classes in your school. **Global** is the average across every class doing that course anywhere.
Longer bars mean more, and the number at the end of each bar is the figure itself. A class with too little recorded activity shows a dash rather than an invented bar.
steps.terminal: That's the benchmark — your class, your school, everyone. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
